listing.name: Cyber Troopers Virtual-On — virtualon_pc (drakenabarion)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream explicitly says original VirtualOn omg boots/menus/matches and audio; online unavailable. No complete-game or Portcove component qualification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS4 VirtualOnMasterpiece CUSA16156 decrypted collection folder with eboot.bin,pjv3.elf,sce_module,sce_sys and assets. Select original VirtualOn component omg, not ot/force. Exact update/digests unbound.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Manual collection Virtual-On-x86_64.AppImage/WindowsZIP or build.sh; select own folder and omg component in launcher (or BB_EXE=omg). Shared native collection runtime, no new perhost/launcher identity.
